name: chatgpt-web-harness-desktop
description: ChatGPT Web Harness 桌面启动器：初始化、启停 MCP 与 Secure MCP Tunnel，并集中显示实时活动日志

scripts.test: npm run smoke && npm run test:migration && npm run test:node-shim && node scripts/test-zip-safety.mjs && node scripts/test-payload-manifest.mjs
scripts.dist: node scripts/stage-harness.mjs && node scripts/patch-portable-template.mjs && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist:portable: node scripts/stage-harness.mjs && node scripts/patch-portable-template.mjs && electron-builder --win portable --config electron-builder.yml
